verdicts.argument: The default applies only to the one caller that omits the argument: junitRootFailures' `declared()` (junitTestCases passes its own legacyQuotes). With the default true, decodeJUnitValue first rewrites `&quot;` to `"`, so after decoding a value reads `"` where it read `"`; nothing else changes. declared() reads only the `failures` and `errors` values (attribute NAMES are lowercased, never decoded), through `Number.parseInt(raw.trim(), 10)`. parseInt reads the leading run of decimal digits after optional sign and white space; neither `"` nor `&` is a digit, sign or white space, and `trim()` removes neither, so both spellings yield the same digit prefix (or the same NaN when the substitution leads). The count, hence junitRootFailures, the projection header and the --freeze refusal, cannot differ.
